captured_from: Field names and types of a Claude Code SubagentStop hook payload, derived from two evidence sources on 2026-09-17: (a) the fields the shipped hooks actually read — hooks/pan-cost-logger.js buildCostRecord/resolveAgentTranscript and hooks/pan-trace-logger.js buildTraceEvents — together with the payload shapes their suites already pin (tests/cost-logger-hook.test.cjs, tests/trace-logger.test.cjs) and the field list documented in docs/HOOKS.md under pan-cost-logger.js; (b) the structure of a local Claude Code transcript tree on this machine, read on 2026-09-17 to confirm the parent-session-plus-per-agent layout the payload addresses. Structure only: no project name, path, prose, code or business detail was copied out of that tree, and every value below is neutral synthetic.

placeholders.{{SESSION_ID}}: the host session id; the test substitutes a synthetic one that also names the subagents/ directory
placeholders.{{TRANSCRIPT_PATH}}: absolute path of the PARENT session transcript the host hands the hook
placeholders.{{PROJECT_DIR}}: absolute path of the project the hook writes its ledger row into
placeholders.{{AGENT_ID}}: the host's per-spawn agent id; resolves <parent dir>/<session_id>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl

notes: `usage` is deliberately implausible (a cumulative session counter, which is what the host really sends on this event — docs/HOOKS.md). The agent transcript in subagent-transcripts-claude.json holds the true per-spawn counts, so a row built from `usage` instead of the agent transcript is visibly wrong rather than merely different. Omitted on purpose because the hooks do not read them and no local evidence fixes their shape: `model`, `phase`, `command`, `exit_code`, `agent_transcript_path`. docs/HOOKS.md records that real payloads carried no `model` or `phase`, and that `usage` is absent entirely in headless mode.
